old_problem: No vendor completion-suppression mechanism, requester/completer transaction path, timeout-range semantics, non-fatal severity/AER oracle, permitted recovery, data-integrity gate, clear or restoration exists.
disposition_reason: Completion Timeout is transaction-layer behavior, not replay timing or an arbitrary AER bit. ED-02/03/15/16/19 require this variant's exact path and authoritative non-fatal recovery; suppressing a completion cannot be guessed. Pending/BLOCKED remains.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA PCIe Completion Timeout non-fatal recovery
test_case.purpose: After approval, withhold or delay one completion for one mapped safe transaction, prove target-correlated uncorrectable-nonfatal Completion Timeout reporting, and recover only the affected function without host reset or data loss.
required_package: Exact completion suppression/delay mechanism and timeout-range semantics
Expected Completion Timeout AER/severity/root/OS fields and deadline
Permitted function/driver recovery, no-host-reset/link-loss/data-corruption rules, OOB recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED: the source has only a label. Do not alter timeout ranges or suppress completions. Once the complete vendor transaction and recovery contract is approved, perform a fresh review and permit one traced transaction timeout only.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped request exceeds the signed range and produces the expected uncorrectable-nonfatal Completion Timeout propagation; no fatal escalation, host reset/hang, link loss, unrelated impact or data corruption occurs, and the approved function recovery restores service and configuration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while the transaction, command and Criteria are missing. Uncorrelated/stale status, wrong severity, broad stall, host reset, link/device loss, data mismatch or incomplete recovery fails or remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Isolated recoverable device with disposable verified data and independent OOB/console.
Approved transaction, timeout mechanism and function-recovery path before injection.
One completion event once; no retry.
Abort on fatal escalation, broad traffic stall, host reset/hang, link loss or corruption.
expected_evidence: Timeout range, AER masks/severity/status, link, driver and data/workload baseline
Exact one-shot delayed/withheld completion with transaction identifier and timeline
Fresh mapped Completion Timeout nonfatal/root/OS evidence
No fatal/host/link/unrelated impact; restored function/service and matching data hash
Approved clear/config restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve transaction/AER/reset evidence, then apply only the approved function/driver recovery. Restore timeout/mask/injector state, verify link, driver, service and data hash. Use OOB for host instability and do not automatically retry.
